CustomObject.description: The Field Action Checklist Assignment object says which Field Action Checklist a review gets for a Part or a Part Family (one or the other). A part's own assignment wins over its family's; with neither, the default checklist applies. Commonly used for setting checklists by product line.
CustomObject.label: Field Action Checklist Assignment

validationRules.errorMessage: Choose a Part or a Part Family, not both.
